author: MandaloreGaming
description:
The Sinking City is an open world detective horror game set directly in Lovecraft's works with a nice Remastered edition that came out in 2025. So something like a curated Call of Cthulhu campaign. I was prepared for fishmen, but I wasn't prepared for what other nefarious lads were doing dark deeds in those fishmen alleys.
